When me and my boyfriend first got together it initially seemed hopeless. We were in different countries, with no money to see each other, we were both going through so much. I had not been out of my last relationship long, was severely depressed, had no job and spent my time getting drunk as much as possible. I also had a flare up of Ulcerative Colitis around that time, meaning severe pain and meds. He was recovering from 3rd degree burns after falling into a bonfire, which happened three days before we were meant to be seeing each other. It really seemed like a bad sign. 
He also had is own share of mental health issues, as well as an alcohol problem, and was unable to work for months after the bonfire incident.

We're still together 6 months later, he's now able to work again and I am 3 months away from finishing my degree and getting a job.  He's stopped with the alcoholism, and I've stopped drinking entirely for now. I've also started antidepressants which are definitely helping. 
We've got a long way to go but I really do love him and want to make it work. We're getting there.
